name: ab_prime_mul_prime_abundant
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) : Nat.Abundant (p * q)
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime), Nat.Abundant (p * q)
informal: Task 3(b) literally: product of two primes is abundant. FALSE (2*3 = 6 is perfect).
original: If p1 and p2 are primes, then p1p2 is abundant.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → (p * q).Abundant
